game.title: Fight for the Right
game.tagline: The battle for the glimmerite fields of New Aurora
map.kristalltal.name: Crystal Valley
map.kristalltal.desc: 2 players · Land only, great for learning
faction.aero.desc: Fast, agile and cheap – but lightly armoured.
faction.granite.desc: Heavy, tough, unstoppable – but pricier and slower.
skirmish.title: Skirmish vs AI
settings.title: Settings
credits.title: Credits
credits.text: A hobby project for friends and kids. All graphics, characters, sounds and music are drawn or generated by the game itself – there are no third-party images or sounds. Software used: Phaser, Colyseus, Zod, Vite, Vitest, TypeScript (all freely licensed).
guide.title: How to play
guide.goal.title: What's it about?
guide.goal.text: Pick one of six teams – Aero League, Granite Union, Volt Collective, Cloud Corsairs, Ice Expedition or Jungle Rangers. Collect glimmerite crystals, build a base and an army – and defeat the enemy base. Whoever has no buildings and no construction wagon left loses.
guide.start.title: Getting started
guide.start.1: Select your construction wagon and deploy it (house button or D key). It turns into the construction yard.
guide.start.2: Build a power plant: tap it in the build bar on the right, wait for «Ready», tap it again and place it next to the yard.
guide.start.3: Build a refinery – a harvester will then collect crystals by itself.
guide.start.4: Barracks for riflemen, factory for tanks. Later: radar, tech center, airfield and shipyard.
guide.start.5: Gather a mixed army and attack! Tip: the campaign mission «Landing on New Aurora» shows everything step by step.
guide.mouse.title: Mouse controls
guide.touch.title: Touch controls
guide.economy.title: Glimmerite and money
guide.economy.1: Harvesters drive to the crystals and bring them to the refinery – that's how you earn glimmerite.
guide.economy.2: Crystals slowly grow back. More refineries and harvesters = more money.
guide.economy.3: If storage is full, buy something or build a silo.
guide.economy.4: Grey glimmerite sources (bonus points) earn money once an engineer takes them over.
guide.power.title: Power
guide.power.text: Almost every building needs power. The bar at the top shows production and use. With too little power, building slows down, towers fire slower and the radar switches off – just build another power plant.
guide.units.title: Who beats whom?
guide.units.text: No unit is strong against everything. Mix your army!
guide.units.legend: Small symbols in the top left of the build bar show what a unit is especially strong against. Tap the «i» to see stars for every kind of target: 5 stars = very effective, 1 star = barely, «can't hit» = not at all. Tap a unit on the map and the table appears at the bottom of the sidebar.
rating.title: Effective against
guide.units.rifleman: Strong against riflemen, weak against tanks.
guide.units.rocketeer: Strong against tanks and helicopters, weak against riflemen.
guide.units.lightTank: Strong against riflemen and vehicles, can't shoot upwards.
guide.units.artillery: Fires very far, strong against buildings – but helpless up close.
guide.units.flakWagon: Brings helicopters and aircraft down, weak against ground troops.
guide.units.gunship: Strong against vehicles – only flak and rockets can hit it.
guide.units.engineer: Doesn't fight: repairs your buildings and takes over others.
guide.tips.title: Tips
guide.tips.1: With A and a click your units attack everything on the way (attack move).
guide.tips.2: Repair damaged buildings: select the building, press the wrench.
guide.tips.3: Towers at your base entrances hold off early attacks.
guide.tips.4: Transports carry troops across water: select units, tap the transport.
guide.tips.5: Space jumps to the latest message, Esc pauses the game.

help.title: Controls
help.mouse.1: Left click: select · Drag a box: select several · Double click: all of that type on screen
help.mouse.2: Right click: move, attack, harvest (depends on target) · Right drag: pan the map
help.mouse.3: A: attack move · S: stop · D: deploy construction wagon
help.mouse.4: Screen edge, arrow keys (WASD without selection): camera · Wheel: zoom
help.mouse.5: Ctrl+number: save group · Number: select group (twice = jump to it)
help.mouse.6: Space: jump to last message · Esc: cancel / pause
help.touch.1: Tap: select · Double tap: all of that type on screen
help.touch.2: With a selection, tap ground/enemy/crystals: move, attack, harvest
help.touch.3: Long press and drag: selection box
help.touch.4: Drag (1 or 2 fingers): pan the map · Two fingers: zoom
help.touch.5: Build bar: tap = build, long press = pause/cancel
help.touch.6: Group buttons: tap = select, long press = save

map.nebelwald.name: Misty Woods
campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.intro: Pick a side. Every mission you win unlocks the next one. The stars show which difficulty levels you have beaten.
mission.victoryText: Mission complete! The next mission is unlocked.
mission.defeatText: Not this time. Give it another try!
mission.a1.title: Landing on New Aurora
mission.a1.briefing:
Welcome to New Aurora, Commander! Glimmerite sparkles beneath this meadow – enough to build a whole fleet.
Unfortunately the Granite Union has set up an outpost to the north. I'll show you step by step how to build a base. Then we'll send the Granite folks home!
mission.a1.goal.base: Build a base: construction yard, power plant, refinery, barracks, factory
mission.a1.goal.army: Raise an army of 8 combat units
mission.a1.goal.outpost: Destroy the Granite outpost in the north-east
mission.a1.o.deploy: Select the construction wagon and deploy it (house button or D key)
mission.a1.o.power: Build a power plant and place it next to the construction yard
mission.a1.o.refinery: Build a refinery – it comes with a harvester
mission.a1.m.welcome: Hi! I'm Lyra. First select your construction wagon and deploy it – it turns into your construction yard.
mission.a1.m.power: Great, the yard is up! Nothing works without power: build a power plant. When it's ready, place it next to the yard.
mission.a1.m.refinery: It's humming! Now a refinery. A harvester will then drive to the crystals by itself.
mission.a1.m.barracks: Glimmerite is flowing! The barracks train riflemen.
mission.a1.m.factory: Nice. For tanks you need a factory.
mission.a1.m.army: Now build a small army: 8 combat units. Tip: mixing tanks and riflemen is strong.
mission.a1.m.attack: Ready! I've marked the outpost on the map. Select your army and attack – with A and a click they attack everything on the way.
mission.a1.m.controls: Tip: drag a box to select several units. Right-click or tap the ground to send them off.
mission.a1.m.raid: Watch out, Granite scouts are attacking our base! Defend yourself!
mission.a1.m.won: The outpost is gone – New Aurora is ours! Well done!
mission.a2.title: Rescue in the Mist
mission.a2.briefing:
Emergency! Our researcher Dr. Ida Quarz is being held by the Granite Union in the Misty Woods.
You get 6 jetpack scouts and 2 hover tanks – no base, no reinforcements. The scouts fly over the forest, the tanks glide over water. Free Ida and bring her to the pickup point in the north-west.
mission.a2.goal.rescue: Reach the camp in the east and free Dr. Quarz
mission.a2.goal.escort: Bring her to the pickup point in the north-west
mission.a2.goal.survive: At least one combat unit must make it
mission.a2.o.rescue: Free Dr. Quarz in the camp to the east
mission.a2.o.escort: Bring Dr. Quarz to the pickup point in the north-west
mission.a2.m.start: We have landed! The camp is to the east – follow the yellow arrow at the edge of the screen. Guards stand at the bridges, maybe you can find a quieter way.
mission.a2.m.forest: Tip: the scouts fly over trees and water. The hover tanks can glide across the river.
mission.a2.m.freed: Finally! Thank you for coming! I'll walk with you – please look after me.
mission.a2.m.toPickup: Great! Bring Ida to the pickup point in the top left corner (north-west). The yellow flag and the arrow at the edge of the screen show the way – the 📍 button in the goals takes you there.
mission.a2.m.alarm: Alarm! The prisoner is gone! After them!
mission.a2.m.won: Ida is safe! The airlift is picking everyone up. Masterful!
mission.g1.title: The Wall Holds
mission.g1.briefing:
Commander, the Aero League wants to push us out of the Valley of the Four Winds. Their waves come from the east and the south – and they keep getting stronger.
Hold the base for 15 minutes until our reinforcements arrive. The construction yard must not fall!
mission.g1.goal.hq: The construction yard must stay standing
mission.g1.m.start: Base manned! Build defence towers at the entrances and train troops – the first wave is coming soon.
mission.g1.m.tip: Tip: cannon towers against tanks, MG towers against riflemen. Don't forget to repair!
mission.g1.m.air: Watch out, helicopters on the horizon! Flak wagons or a flak position will bring them down.
mission.g1.m.half: Half time! The wall holds. Keep it up!
mission.g1.m.final: The Aero League throws everything into battle – this is the last wave! Hold on!
mission.g1.m.won: Reinforcements have arrived! The wall held – brilliant!
mission.g2.title: Counterstrike
mission.g2.briefing:
Now we turn the tables! The Aero League has dug in on an island in the south-east – with an airfield, a shipyard and a rocket battery.
Expand your base, secure glimmerite and get your troops across the sea: with ships, helicopters or transports. Destroy the entire Aero base!
mission.g2.goal.cross: Cross the sea with ships, helicopters or transports
mission.g2.o.destroy: Destroy the Aero base in the south-east
mission.g2.m.start: The Aero League has been warned – they're already building. We must be quick!
mission.g2.m.tip: Tip: a shipyard must be built by the water. Transport helicopters and landing boats carry tanks to other islands.
mission.g2.m.middle: There's plenty of glimmerite on the middle island. Whoever holds it has more money!
mission.g2.m.won: The Aero base is defeated! The Granite Union celebrates you!
faction.corsair.desc: Friendly sky pirates – cheap and nimble, but lightly built.
faction.frost.desc: Polar explorers – sturdy and tough, but slow.
faction.jungle.desc: Camouflage and nature – invisible while standing still.
mission.lost.convoy: Too many convoy harvesters were lost.
mission.a2.m.campHint: Tip: the prison camp is on the far right of the map. The yellow arrow points there.
mission.a2.m.pickupHint: We need to get to the pickup point in the top left! Select me and tap the yellow flag.
mission.a3.title: Bridgehead
mission.a3.briefing:
The Granite Union has dug in on the east bank of the great river. As long as they hold the middle bridge, we cannot cross.
Build your base on the west bank, take the bridge and then destroy their base.
mission.a3.goal.base: Build a base on the west bank
mission.a3.goal.destroy: Destroy the Granite base in the north-east
mission.a3.o.bridge: Take the middle bridge (move 3 units there)
mission.a3.o.destroy: Destroy the Granite base in the north-east
mission.a3.m.start: Deploy your wagon and build an army. The bridge is well guarded – attack with several units at once!
mission.a3.m.bridge: The bridge is ours! Reinforcements are on their way. Now on to the Granite base!
mission.a3.m.tip: Tip: with a shipyard by the water you can also build boats.
mission.a3.m.won: The east bank is clear! The bridge stays in our hands.
mission.a4.title: Glimmerite Convoy
mission.a4.briefing:
Four fully loaded harvesters must reach the depot in the north-east. Granite ambushes lie in wait along the way.
You have no base – only your escort. Clear the way and bring the harvesters safely to their destination.
mission.a4.goal.depot: Bring the harvesters to the depot in the north-east
mission.a4.o.depot: Bring the harvesters to the depot (yellow flag)
mission.a4.m.start: The harvesters wait in the bottom left. Send the tanks ahead first and let the harvesters follow only when the way is clear.
mission.a4.m.tip: Tip: select the harvesters with a box, then tap the yellow flag at the depot.
mission.a4.m.reinforce: Reinforcements: bikes and tanks have arrived at the start!
mission.a4.m.won: The harvesters made it to the depot – the glimmerite is saved!
mission.a5.title: Island Hopping
mission.a5.briefing:
Two glimmerite sources bubble on the middle island. Whoever owns them is rich!
Fly or ship your engineers across, take over both sources and hold them until our settlers arrive.
mission.a5.goal.cross: Cross the sea to the middle island
mission.a5.goal.capture: Take over both glimmerite sources with engineers
mission.a5.goal.hold: Hold the sources for a while
mission.a5.o.capture: Take over both glimmerite sources on the middle island
mission.a5.m.start: Build an airfield or a shipyard. A transport helicopter carries 5 infantry at once – engineers too!
mission.a5.m.tip: Tip: select units and tap the transport = board. Over the island press «Unload».
mission.a5.m.captured: Both sources are ours! The Granite Union is sending helicopters – hold on!
mission.a5.m.won: The settlers have landed – the middle island belongs to the Aero League!
mission.a6.title: Storming the Forge
mission.a6.briefing:
In the forge in the south-east the Granite Union builds its heaviest tanks. Their commander is tough – even on «Easy» he is already clever.
Build a strong economy and destroy the forge.
mission.a6.goal.destroy: Destroy the forge in the south-east
mission.a6.o.destroy: Destroy the Granite forge in the south-east
mission.a6.m.start: There are plenty of crystals – a second refinery pays off early!
mission.a6.m.tip: Tip: rocket soldiers crack tanks, tanks crack riflemen. Mix your army!
mission.a6.m.center: The biggest crystal field lies in the middle. Whoever holds it wins the arms race.
mission.a6.m.won: The forge has fallen silent – brilliant!
mission.a7.title: Two Fronts
mission.a7.briefing:
Two Granite bases in the south threaten us. Luckily an allied Aero squadron in the north-east stands by our side.
Attack together and destroy both bases.
mission.a7.goal.ally: Work together with the allied squadron
mission.a7.goal.destroy: Destroy both Granite bases in the south
mission.a7.o.sw: Destroy the Granite base in the south-west
mission.a7.o.se: Destroy the Granite base in the south-east
mission.a7.m.start: Our allies (green) will help you. Pick one base first – two fronts at once is too much.
mission.a7.m.tip: Tip: attack together with the allies – their tanks set off on their own once they are strong enough.
mission.a7.m.oneDown: One base has fallen! Keep it up!
mission.a7.m.won: Both bases are defeated – the south is free!
mission.a8.title: Endgame for New Aurora
mission.a8.briefing:
The Granite Union bets everything: three island bases surround us.
Build an air fleet and ships, defeat one island after another – and New Aurora belongs to the Aero League for good!
mission.a8.goal.build: Build an air fleet and ships
mission.a8.o.ne: Defeat the Granite island in the north-east
mission.a8.o.se: Defeat the Granite island in the south-east
mission.a8.o.sw: Defeat the Granite island in the south-west
mission.a8.m.start: This is the final battle, Commander. Secure the middle island and its glimmerite first!
mission.a8.m.tip: Tip: flak wagons and flak positions protect you from bomber airships.
mission.a8.m.oneDown: One island is free! The Granite Union is wavering!
mission.a8.m.won: New Aurora is free! The whole Aero League celebrates you – Commander, you are a legend!
mission.g3.title: Mole Tunnels
mission.g3.briefing:
An Aero outpost in the north-east is guarded by towers – but they need power!
Sneak in underground with the moles, take over their power plant with an engineer and then destroy the outpost.
mission.g3.goal.sneak: Sneak in unseen with the moles
mission.g3.goal.power: Take over the Aero power plant with an engineer
mission.g3.o.power: Take over the Aero power plant in the outpost
mission.g3.m.start: Engineers into the moles! As long as a mole is moving it is invisible underground.
mission.g3.m.tip: Tip: select engineers and tap a mole = board. Unload next to the power plant and tap it.
mission.g3.m.power: Power plant captured – their towers are without power! A construction wagon has arrived.
mission.g3.m.powerLost: The power plant is destroyed – also fine, their towers are weakened. Here is a construction wagon!
mission.g3.m.won: The outpost is history. Neat work, moles!
mission.g4.title: Hold the Bridges
mission.g4.briefing:
The Aero League wants to push across the three bridges of the great river – and over the water and through the air too.
Hold your base for 12 minutes. The construction yard must not fall!
mission.g4.goal.hq: The construction yard must stay standing
mission.g4.goal.water: Fend off boats and aircraft too
mission.g4.m.start: Place towers at the bridgeheads. Mortars hit enemies behind obstacles too.
mission.g4.m.boats: Missile boats on the river! Cannon towers on the shore or your own boats help.
mission.g4.m.air: Helicopters incoming – get the flak ready!
mission.g4.m.final: The last wave is coming – everything they have!
mission.g4.m.won: The bridges held! The Aero League retreats.
mission.g5.title: Hunt in the Misty Woods
mission.g5.briefing:
Three Aero radar posts hide in the Misty Woods and report every move we make.
Find and destroy all three. You have no base – but we send reinforcements for every post destroyed.
mission.g5.goal.find: Find and destroy three radar posts
mission.g5.o.r1: Destroy the radar post in the north-west
mission.g5.o.r2: Destroy the radar post in the eastern camp
mission.g5.o.r3: Destroy the radar post in the south-east
mission.g5.m.start: The yellow flags show where the posts are suspected. Do not split your squad too much!
mission.g5.m.tip: Tip: the flak protects against dragonfly copters, the steel robot clears infantry.
mission.g5.m.patrol: Intruders in the woods! Patrol, go!
mission.g5.m.one: One post fewer! Reinforcements are on their way.
mission.g5.m.won: All radar posts are destroyed – the Aero League is blind!
mission.g6.title: Iron Fist
mission.g6.briefing:
The Aero League has built a strong base with rocket batteries in the south-east.
Secure the glimmerite source north of the middle, arm yourself and strike with an iron fist!
mission.g6.goal.source: Take over the glimmerite source with the engineer
mission.g6.goal.destroy: Destroy the Aero base in the south-east
mission.g6.o.destroy: Destroy the Aero base in the south-east
mission.g6.m.start: Send the engineer to the glimmerite source – it brings in money all the time.
mission.g6.m.tip: Tip: shield bearers protect nearby infantry, the colossus can take a lot.
mission.g6.m.source: The source is ours – the glimmerite flows!
mission.g6.m.won: The Aero base is smashed. Iron fist!
mission.g7.title: Air Battle
mission.g7.briefing:
Two Aero island bases send helicopters and fighters against us. Their strength is the air.
Build flak, then cross with ships or transports and defeat both islands.
mission.g7.o.ne: Defeat the Aero island in the north-east
mission.g7.o.sw: Defeat the Aero island in the south-west
mission.g7.m.start: Flak positions around the base and hail flak with the troops – then let them come!
mission.g7.m.tip: Tip: bomber airships and steam cruisers are strong against island bases.
mission.g7.m.air: Squadron, take off! Show those ground crawlers!
mission.g7.m.oneDown: One island is defeated! On to the next!
mission.g7.m.won: The sky is ours again – both islands are defeated!
mission.g8.title: The Last Bastion
mission.g8.briefing:
Three Aero bases have encircled us in the Valley of the Four Winds. There is only one way left: forward!
Hold your bastion and defeat all three bases.
mission.g8.o.ne: Defeat the Aero base in the north-east
mission.g8.o.se: Defeat the Aero base in the south-east
mission.g8.o.sw: Defeat the Aero base in the south-west
mission.g8.m.start: They attack from three sides. Build defences first, then strike one base after another!
mission.g8.m.tip: Tip: the middle of the valley has the most glimmerite – secure it early.
mission.g8.m.oneDown: One base has fallen! The bastion stands!
mission.g8.m.won: All three bases are defeated – the Granite Union triumphs! Commander, you are a legend!
